size_rules.mid: Rust LOC >= 2000 and < 50000 and workspace crates <= 20
size_rules.sample_class: fixture = rust-loop* harness trees; real = pinned crates and public mid/large samples
size_rules.fitness_method: official_first_rebuild (rust_loop_bench) vs restore_rebuild_mean_of_medians (PR #11). Do not compare fitness_ms across methods.
size_rules.cache_state: empty = cleared target and compiler cache; warm_compiler_cache = sccache/nanocompile/kache retained across emptied target/ or a sibling worktree
size_rules.shape: recorded on classify (normal / proc_macro / async_web / generic). Not an occupancy axis: a third axis would vacate the stalled size×edit grid.
size_rules.worktree: edit=worktree is a sibling checkout with a new CARGO_TARGET_DIR and a shared compiler cache. That is kache's advertised hit.

design_notes: Two axes (size x edit) yield 12 cells. Disk usage is a recorded metric, not a third axis: a disk tertile would triple the grid and leave most cells empty while four agents are still seeding.

Fitness is median wall time in milliseconds of the configured iteration loop (genome.loop: check, graph, test, or build) on that edit type. Lower is better. Spread is population stdev of the timed samples. loop=build is the cranelift-dev gene; cargo check skips codegen so cranelift cannot occupy a check-loop cell on merit.

validate is not a gene. It is always cargo test with default LLVM rustc. A genome that fails the correctness gate (fast path and rustc must agree on broken edits; validate is the final signal) cannot occupy a cell.
Replace an elite only when the new median is at least fitness.min_gain_pct faster (default 3%) and correctness.ok is true. Seed an empty cell with the first passing evaluation.
Stop a cell after fitness.max_non_improving consecutive non-improving tries. Hill-climb restarts may re-seed a stopped cell with a new genome family.
Do not stack RUSTC_WRAPPER=nanocompile with sccache or kache. Compiler caches are mutually exclusive. Cranelift is a dev-backend gene only; rust-loop run strips it from validate.
Other agents write bench/archive/<sample>.json shards. Merge with `nanocompile map-elites merge` or `python3 tools/map_elites.py merge`.
Size is by Rust LOC: small < 2000, mid 2000..50000 and <=20 crates. rust-loop-medium (202 LOC) is small; do not let it occupy mid.

fitness_method is recorded per elite. official_first_rebuild supersedes restore_rebuild_mean_of_medians so the grid unifies on this harness. Do not compare raw ms across methods when reading older shards.
cache_state=warm_compiler_cache means sccache/nanocompile survived an emptied target/. It is not true empty-cache cold and does not set the iteration default.
package_scope=touched (cargo check -p hub) fails the sig_dep correctness gate unless dependents_agree_on_broken. Fallback elite is workspace check.
Promote weights real samples (midsize, pinned-*) over rust-loop fixtures. Fixture cells stay sample-specific when real elites exist.
Held-out rows (held_out=true, sample contains -held-out, or sample contains -from-) never occupy a cell. Cross-tests must use those names so a faster transfer cannot steal the trained-on elite.
worktree is a fifth edit, not a third occupancy axis. Shape (proc_macro / async_web / generic / normal) is classify metadata only.
kache is RUSTC_WRAPPER=kache with an isolated KACHE_CACHE_DIR. Tag cache_state=empty for an honestly cold store and warm_compiler_cache when warm_store=true (including sibling worktrees).
loop=clippy and loop=nextest are timed iteration genes only. The correctness gate stays cargo test + LLVM rustc.

Additional genes that actually run here: linker (default/lld/mold; wild skipped if missing), debuginfo including split-unpacked/split-packed, codegen-units, profile.dev.package.* opt-level, -Zshare-generics, -Zthreads, -Zhint-mostly-unused, Cranelift, CARGO_INCREMENTAL on/off, target-dir on tmpfs (/dev/shm).
